_comment: Citation policy for case-briefing pages. A case page may cite ONLY court and docket records, official case-administration sites, government releases, the subject company's own disclosures, and reputable general/financial/legal media. No crypto trade blogs, no aggregators, no case-tracker sites, and never a competitor. Enforced by tests/prerender.test.js. Add an outlet here rather than making an exception on a page.
companyDisclosure: Company filings and the subject's own announcements qualify regardless of host (an 8-K, a plan administrator notice, an official case blog). List the exact official channel under companyDisclosureUrls so every exception stays auditable — never allowlist a generic host like medium.com or substack.com outright.
